title: WP NMKR Connect 🔌 - WordPress Plugin to Display & Manage Cardano/Solana NFTs

ms.promise:

ms.report:
A. Output: Security audit and verification

A relevant, explicitly scoped security audit and verification programme was completed for NMKR Connect, building on the Milestone 3 security foundation. The work covered authorization and administrative API boundaries, synchronization recovery authority, SQL/database injection controls, input validation and payload bounds, public analytics ingestion, error disclosure, final rendering/XSS-sensitive paths, static checks, dependency auditing, and cumulative private DEV validation.

A selected set of OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) 5.0.0 requirements was mapped to the project’s exact test and evidence records. The mapping is intentionally bounded and does not claim complete ASVS conformance, penetration-test certification, or universal application security.

Acceptance criteria: The selected security requirements were verified within their stated implementation and test scopes through source analysis, deterministic/synthetic regressions, public CI, package-specific private validation where risk required it, and cumulative private exact-head DEV validation. The evidence demonstrates the effectiveness of the implemented controls within those cited boundaries.

Evidence:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zj-UmoKKXqdwRpUe99sFAnhg_jclkzm2MufmMFpVu70/

B. Output: Identified and resolved vulnerability reporting

The Milestone 4 audit produced and maintained a structured findings register. Confirmed findings S-01, S-02, S-04 and S-05 were resolved within their recorded scopes. S-03 was rejected on the exact inspected baseline. S-06 and A-01 remain explicitly documented as open, narrowed assurance gaps rather than being presented as resolved vulnerabilities.
